summary: The note describes the Edward R. Roybal Federal Building and United States Courthouse, a federal courthouse used by the United States District Court for the Central District of California. It is located in the Civic Center district of Los Angeles, on Temple Street in Downtown Los Angeles. The note is brief and gives only basic identification and location details.
one_line: A federal courthouse of the U.S. District Court for the Central District of California on Temple Street in Downtown Los Angeles.
